ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (black) background to high-intensity (white) linear and patch markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity ovoid patch located at the distal tip of the right lobe; high-intensity linear filaments distributed in multi-directional networks across the medial and proximal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees relative to the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations on the distal left lobe; moderate amplitude oscillations and distinct notches observed along the continuous trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, sweeping outward to distal tips; the right lobe exhibits a more rounded convexity compared to the jagged distal left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of high-contrast circular nodules (barnacle colonization) localized on the high-intensity distal patch of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, non-aligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) covering approximately 65% of the visible fluke surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular erosion/missing tissue sections along the trailing edge of the left lobe tip; dense linear rake mark scarring consistent with interspecific or intraspecific interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity distal tip on the right lobe which serves as a high-contrast focal point against the water background.
